title: Global Warheads Fell While China's Rose To 500
hook: The global arsenal shrank, but China's reached 500 warheads.
closing: Disarmament is harder when one major arsenal grows against the global trend.
question: Can the global decline continue?

segments.say: Global warheads fell to 12,500. Decades of reductions cut the Cold War peak sharply.
China's warheads reached 500. One major arsenal grew while the global total kept falling.
Russia still leads with 5,580 warheads. Older nuclear powers continue to dominate the balance.
